{
 "summary": "I fixed the bug: a `''` in a long string value now survives the `str()` / `Card.fromstring` round trip instead of turning into `'`. A new regression test failed before the change and passes after it.

**Cause:** In `Card._split` (`astropy/io/fits/card.py:862`), the code turned `''` back into `'` in each CONTINUE chunk on its own. `_parse_value` (line 771) then does the same thing again on the joined string. So a doubled quote was converted twice and lost one quote. That only shows up when the value spills onto CONTINUE cards, which is why only some lengths failed.

**Fix:** I removed `.replace("''", "'")` from the per-chunk step, so the joined value still has `''` and is converted exactly once in `_parse_value`. I added a one-line comment there explaining why the quotes stay doubled.

**Test:** I added `TestHeaderFunctions.test_long_string_with_null_string_roundtrip` in `astropy/io/fits/tests/test_header.py`, next to `test_long_string_value_via_fromstring`. No existing test checked a `''` round trip across CONTINUE cards. It covers `"x"*n + "''"` and `"x"*n + "''" + "x"*10` for n from 50 to 79, which includes every failing case in the issue. It checks that the value after the round trip equals the original.

**Verification:**
- **Before the fix:** `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider astropy/io/fits/tests/test_header.py -k null_string_roundtrip` failed with exit code 1, because the parsed value had `'` where the original had `''`.
- **After the fix:** `test_header.py` plus `test_core.py` gave 268 passed, 1 skipped, exit code 0.
- **Whole `astropy/io/fits` test suite:** 1286 passed and 1 failed. The failure is `test_fitstime.py::TestFitsTime::test_time_to_fits_loc[Table]`: it failed with "leap-second auto-update failed", and internet access is disabled in this environment. That file doesn't touch card parsing.

**Changed files:**
- `astropy/io/fits/card.py`
- `astropy/io/fits/tests/test_header.py`

**Still to do:**
- Astropy expects a changelog entry at `docs/changes/io.fits/<PR#>.bugfix.rst`, and I didn't add one because the PR number doesn't exist yet. Add it once there is a PR number.
- Commit and push are left to you."
}

I fixed it: a long string value containing `''` now comes back unchanged after `str()` and `Card.fromstring`. The new regression test and the existing header and core tests pass.

**Cause:** every failing value in the issue is over 68 characters once its quotes are escaped, so it is written across `CONTINUE` cards. When reading those back, `Card._split` in `astropy/io/fits/card.py` turned each `''` back into `'` for each piece. It then put the joined pieces back in quotes, and `_parse_value` turned `''` into `'` a second time. So an intended `''` came back as `'`. The results only looked right when the escaped `''` pair happened to be cut between two cards, because then each half survived the first pass.

**Fix:** I removed `.replace("''", "'")` from `_split`, so escaped quotes are now turned back exactly once, in `_parse_value`. That also covers a pair cut across two cards, since joining the pieces restores it before the single pass. I added a comment there explaining this.

**Test:** I added `test_long_string_with_doubled_quotes_roundtrip` to `astropy/io/fits/tests/test_header.py`, next to `test_long_string_value_via_fromstring`. No existing test checked this round trip. It covers lengths 50 to 69, with and without 10 trailing characters, which are the issue's two loops.
- **Before the fix:** `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider astropy/io/fits/tests/test_header.py -k doubled_quotes` gave 17 failed and 23 passed. The failures were the expected ones, with `''` read back as `'`.
- **After the fix:** `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider astropy/io/fits/tests/test_header.py astropy/io/fits/tests/test_core.py` gave 307 passed and 1 skipped.

I did not run the rest of the `astropy/io/fits` tests.

**Changed files:** `astropy/io/fits/card.py` and `astropy/io/fits/tests/test_header.py`. Nothing is committed or pushed.

**Still needed from you:**
- Run the rest of the FITS tests if you want them.
- Add a changelog entry in `docs/changes/io.fits/<PR>.bugfix.rst`. I left it out because the PR number isn't known yet.
- Commit and push.
